items.name: ECC
items.summary: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。
items.summary_en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.

items.name: agency-agents
items.summary: Agency-agents是一个开源框架，旨在简化多智能体AI系统的构建。它通过提供预配置的专用智能体，解决协调多样化AI能力的复杂性。每个智能体具有独特的个性和处理流程，支持模块化协作，适用于前端开发、内容审核等特定任务。开发者可通过API快速部署智能体，定制现有智能体以适应新领域，或组合它们构建复杂工作流。该框架适用于自动化多步骤、多专业知识项目，鼓励用户创建智能体团队解决实际问题。
items.summary_en: Agency-agents is an open-source framework that simplifies building multi-agent AI systems by providing pre-configured specialized agents, addressing the complexity of coordinating diverse AI capabilities. Its key insight is structuring agents with distinct personalities and processes, enabling modular collaboration where each agent handles specific tasks like frontend development or content moderation. Developers can deploy these agents via the provided API, customize existing agents for new domains, or combine them to create complex workflows, making it practical for automating multi-step projects requiring varied expertise.

items.name: pytorch
items.summary: PyTorch是一个开源深度学习框架，让研究人员和开发者能够灵活构建和训练神经网络。其核心特色是动态计算图机制，可在运行时直观调试和修改模型结构，大大提升了实验迭代效率。框架提供强大的GPU加速支持，适用于计算机视觉、自然语言处理等多种AI任务。你可以用它快速实现自定义网络架构，或基于预训练模型进行微调，解决实际机器学习问题。这种设计理念特别适合需要频繁调整模型的研究场景，让复杂算法的实现变得更加直观可控。
items.summary_en: PyTorch is an open-source deep learning framework that enables researchers and developers to build and train neural networks with flexibility and ease. Its defining feature is dynamic computational graphs, which allow for intuitive model debugging and modification during runtime. You can use it for everything from computer vision experiments to natural language processing projects, leveraging GPU acceleration for faster training. Try implementing a custom neural architecture or fine-tuning pre-trained models to solve your specific machine learning challenges.

items.name: ui-ux-pro-max-skill
items.summary: 这是一个为多平台专业UI/UX设计提供智能的AI技能。它利用大语言模型理解设计原则，直接生成可用的HTML/CSS代码，适用于落地页、移动界面等场景。开发者或设计师可将其集成到命令行或编码助手（如Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot）中，快速完成原型设计并迭代，无需手写大量样式代码，从而提升设计与开发效率。
items.summary_en: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms. It leverages large language models to understand design principles and generate production-ready code (HTML/CSS) for landing pages, mobile interfaces, and more. Developers and designers can integrate it into their workflow via command-line or coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot, rapidly prototyping and iterating on designs without manual coding.

items.name: clean-code-javascript
items.summary: 这份指南将《代码整洁之道》的核心原则适配到JavaScript，帮助开发者写出可读性强、易于维护的代码。它通过具体示例讲解命名、函数、对象、类、测试和错误处理等最佳实践，强调组合优于继承等设计思想。每一条原则都配有清晰的代码对比，让抽象概念变得直观。你可以将它作为代码审查、重构或团队规范的手册，快速提升代码质量，减少技术债务。无论是初学者还是资深工程师，都能从中获得实用的编码智慧。
items.summary_en: This project adapts Robert C. Martin's clean code principles to JavaScript, helping developers write more readable and maintainable code. It covers naming, functions, objects, classes, testing, and error handling with concrete JS examples, emphasizing composition over inheritance. Use it as a reference for code reviews, refactoring, or team style guides to enforce consistent, high-quality JavaScript.

items.name: caveman
items.summary: caveman项目是一个针对Claude Code的提示工程技巧，通过模仿原始人说话方式（如用'few token'代替'few tokens'）大幅削减token用量，解决大模型交互中token消耗过高的问题。核心原理是利用语言模型对精简表达的理解能力，去除冗余词汇后仍能保持输出质量，减少65%的token，证明并非所有任务都需要详细提示。作为Claude Code的自定义技能使用，适用于代码生成、快速摘要等场景，能有效降低API费用或响应延迟，是一个既有趣又实用的效率实验。
items.summary_en: The caveman project is a minimalist prompt strategy for Claude Code that cuts token usage by 65% using caveman-like speech, addressing high LLM costs. It works by stripping unnecessary words while maintaining output quality, showing that many prompts are overengineered. Apply it as a custom skill for code generation or quick answers to reduce API bills or latency—a simple, practical experiment in prompt efficiency.

items.name: codex-plugin-cc
items.summary: 这个项目充当了 OpenAI Codex 与 Claude Code 之间的桥梁，让用户可以在 Claude Code 环境中直接调用 Codex 进行代码审查或任务委派。其核心设计是一个轻量级插件，通过标准 API 将 Claude 的自然语言指令路由到 Codex，从而结合了两者的优势：Claude 擅长理解和拆解复杂任务，Codex 则专注代码生成与解析。开发者只需安装插件，即可在 Claude Code 的对话流中无缝请求代码审核、自动化测试生成或跨文件重构。典型场景包括：让 Codex 审查 Claude 生成的代码逻辑，或委托 Codex 完成高阶重构任务——无需切换工具，大幅提升开发效率。
items.summary_en: This project bridges OpeAI's Codex with Claude Code, enabling code review and task delegation across both AI assistants. It uses a plugin architecture to route code queries or commands from Claude Code to Codex, combining Claude's natural language understanding with Codex's specialized code generation. Developers can integrate it by installing the plugin and invoking Codex directly from their Claude Code workflow. Typical use cases include automated code review, generating test cases, or refactoring codebases without switching tools.

items.name: agentskills
items.summary: AgentSkills是一套为AI代理技能设计规范和文档的框架，旨在解决不同代理系统间技能互操作与共享的问题。它通过标准化技能描述接口——包含元数据、输入输出模式和执行指令——使各代理能识别并调用同一技能库中的功能。开发者可按规范创建技能包并托管于注册中心，代理可在对话或任务中动态加载调用，实现模块化能力扩展。这一设计降低了代理功能复用的门槛，适合构建开放、可组合的智能体生态。
items.summary_en: AgentSkills is a specification and documentation framework for defining reusable skills that AI agents can discover and execute. It tackles the challenge of agent interoperability by standardizing skill descriptions with metadata, input/output schemas, and execution instructions. Developers can create skill packs following the spec, host them in registries, and allow agents to dynamically load and invoke skills during tasks, enabling modular and extensible agent capabilities.

items.name: checkout
items.summary: GitHub Actions Checkout 是官方提供的用于工作流中检出仓库代码的 Action。它自动处理 Git 认证、浅克隆、子模块等操作，让代码获取快速且稳定。核心优势包括支持稀疏检出、自定义抓取深度和路径过滤，减少不必要的数据传输。典型用例是在 CI/CD 中构建、测试或部署前先取得代码。使用时只需在工作流步骤中添加 `uses: actions/checkout@v4`，之后即可默认访问代码目录。对于复杂项目，还可以通过 `fetch-depth`、`sparse-checkout` 等参数灵活控制，非常适合需要精细管理 Git 操作的自动化场景。
items.summary_en: The GitHub Actions Checkout action is the official tool for checking out a repository in CI/CD workflows. It handles Git operations like authentication, shallow clones, and submodules automatically, making code retrieval fast and reliable. Core strengths include support for sparse checkout, custom fetch depth, and path filtering, reducing unnecessary data transfer. Typical use cases are building, testing, or deploying code after checkout. Use it by adding 'uses: actions/checkout@v4' to a workflow step; then access the code using the default working directory.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: ModernBERT-large
items.summary: ModernBERT-large 是新一代 BERT 模型，专为高效处理长文本而设计，支持长达 8192 token 的上下文。通过集成 Flash Attention、旋转位置编码等现代架构改进，它在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度并降低内存占用。模型可直接用于掩码填充任务，也可微调到文本分类、信息检索等下游场景。其长上下文能力使其特别适合处理整篇文档或长篇内容，为检索增强生成等应用提供了强大基础。
items.summary_en: ModernBERT-large is a BERT variant designed for efficient long-context language understanding, handling sequences up to 8,192 tokens. It incorporates Flash Attention, rotary positional embeddings, and other architectural improvements to speed up inference and reduce memory usage while maintaining accuracy. The model supports fill-mask tasks and can be fine-tuned for downstream applications like text classification or retrieval-augmented generation. Its optimization makes it suitable for processing entire documents or long-form content in production environments.

items.name: Prompt-Guard-86M
items.summary: Prompt-Guard-86M 是 Meta 发布的小型提示注入检测模型，基于 DeBERTa-V2 架构，参数量仅 86M。它的核心用途是作为大语言模型应用的安全前置过滤器，快速区分正常输入与恶意注入提示，有效抵御提示注入攻击。技术亮点在于轻量高效，可无缝集成到推理流水线中，只需通过 Hugging Face Transformers 加载即可进行文本分类。开发者可将其部署为 API 中间件，或在其基础上微调以适应特定的安全策略，从而在不显著增加计算开销的前提下大幅提升 LLM 应用的安全性。
items.summary_en: Prompt-Guard-86M is a lightweight text classifier from Meta designed to detect prompt injection attacks in LLM applications. Based on DeBERTa-V2 with 86M parameters, it offers efficient classification for distinguishing safe prompts from malicious ones. Use it as a security filter before feeding inputs to your LLM pipeline to mitigate injection risks, or fine-tune it for custom safety scenarios.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
